explainer.counted: Refugees from the Democratic Republic of the Congo in France on 31 December 2025, as reported to UNHCR.
explainer.type: A stock: people present at the end of the year, not the number who arrived that year.
explainer.not_included: Asylum seekers, people never registered, and people counted under other groups.
explainer.reliability: Reported to UNHCR, often by the host government. The data does not say, row by row, whether a figure is a government count, a registration count or an estimate.

limitations.detail: UNHCR files every person in this group under 'age unknown' (2025).
The figure went from {n0} to {n1} in one year. The source data doesn't say why; a change in counting can look like real movement.
UNHCR and IDMC both count people displaced inside the country, in different ways. They are shown side by side and never added.
